Fix claim c45 in studies/firstmate-work-handling/claims.json so the study's source check passes. Re-read the cited firstmate file at the study's pinned commit. Then either cite lines that support the claim's main fact (a reopened item's backlog row goes back to Queued) or rewrite the claim to say only what its sources support. If the goal of 20261027-233442-hyv6 is still unmet, also fix 'reopened' in model.json so it is not terminal-success. Before finishing, run `cargo run -p xtask -- site` and the drain source check on the study, and show that the output reports no problem for c45 or any other claim. Acceptance: the site build succeeds; the source check is clean; every claim the change touches cites lines that support it; CHANGELOG.md has an entry; no files change outside the study and CHANGELOG.md.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Two jobs in a row were rejected because study claim c45 was never re-checked against its source, and no follow-up is queued
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass
